question: Could you provide the highest recorded precipitation, minimum temperature, and maximum temperature from the last 15 days of each year from 2013 to 2016 at weather station USW00094846? Ensure each value represents the peak measurement for that period, with precipitation in millimeters and temperatures in degrees Celsius, using only validated data (non-null values and no quality flags)
sql:
-- Get highest precipitation, min temp, max temp for last 15 days of each year 2013-2016
-- Last 15 days = Dec 17-31 (15 days)
-- Values stored as tenths, divide by 10 for mm and °C
WITH yearly_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) AS year,
    MAX(CASE WHEN element = 'PRCP' THEN value / 10.0 ELSE NULL END) AS max_precip_mm,
    MIN(CASE WHEN element = 'TMIN' THEN value / 10.0 ELSE NULL END) AS min_temp_c,
    MAX(CASE WHEN element = 'TMAX' THEN value / 10.0 ELSE NULL END) AS max_temp_c
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_2013`
  WHERE id = 'USW00094846'
    AND date BETWEEN '2013-12-17' AND '2013-12-31'
    AND qflag IS NULL
    AND element IN ('PRCP', 'TMIN', 'TMAX')
  GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) AS year,
    MAX(CASE WHEN element = 'PRCP' THEN value / 10.0 ELSE NULL END) AS max_precip_mm,
    MIN(CASE WHEN element = 'TMIN' THEN value / 10.0 ELSE NULL END) AS min_temp_c,
    MAX(CASE WHEN element = 'TMAX' THEN value / 10.0 ELSE NULL END) AS max_temp_c
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_2014`
  WHERE id = 'USW00094846'
    AND date BETWEEN '2014-12-17' AND '2014-12-31'
    AND qflag IS NULL
    AND element IN ('PRCP', 'TMIN', 'TMAX')
  GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) AS year,
    MAX(CASE WHEN element = 'PRCP' THEN value / 10.0 ELSE NULL END) AS max_precip_mm,
    MIN(CASE WHEN element = 'TMIN' THEN value / 10.0 ELSE NULL END) AS min_temp_c,
    MAX(CASE WHEN element = 'TMAX' THEN value / 10.0 ELSE NULL END) AS max_temp_c
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_2015`
  WHERE id = 'USW00094846'
    AND date BETWEEN '2015-12-17' AND '2015-12-31'
    AND qflag IS NULL
    AND element IN ('PRCP', 'TMIN', 'TMAX')
  GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) AS year,
    MAX(CASE WHEN element = 'PRCP' THEN value / 10.0 ELSE NULL END) AS max_precip_mm,
    MIN(CASE WHEN element = 'TMIN' THEN value / 10.0 ELSE NULL END) AS min_temp_c,
    MAX(CASE WHEN element = 'TMAX' THEN value / 10.0 ELSE NULL END) AS max_temp_c
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_2016`
  WHERE id = 'USW00094846'
    AND date BETWEEN '2016-12-17' AND '2016-12-31'
    AND qflag IS NULL
    AND element IN ('PRCP', 'TMIN', 'TMAX')
  GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date)
)
SELECT year, max_precip_mm, min_temp_c, max_temp_c
FROM yearly_stats
ORDER BY year

function.name: run_sql_query
function.arguments:
{"sql": "-- Get highest precipitation, min temp, max temp for last 15 days of each year 2013-2016
-- Last 15 days = Dec 17-31 (15 days)
-- Values stored as tenths, divide by 10 for mm and °C
WITH yearly_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) AS year,
    MAX(CASE WHEN element = 'PRCP' THEN value / 10.0 ELSE NULL END) AS max_precip_mm,
    MIN(CASE WHEN element = 'TMIN' THEN value / 10.0 ELSE NULL END) AS min_temp_c,
    MAX(CASE WHEN element = 'TMAX' THEN value / 10.0 ELSE NULL END) AS max_temp_c
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_2013`
  WHERE id = 'USW00094846'
    AND date BETWEEN '2013-12-17' AND '2013-12-31'
